newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Forint eases vs dlr, BCE yen, Ecu futures active.
newsitem.headline: Forint eases vs dlr, BCE yen, Ecu futures active.

text.p: The Hungarian forint closed the Monday session slightly weaker against the dollar as it followed the dollar/mark elsewhere in Europe, dealers said.
The forint closed at 155.60/65 against the dollar compared with its opening of 155.50/53.
"The market was in an extremely calm mood," said Gabor Butor of Unicbank, addng that turnover was very low, with the forint hugging the central bank bid throughout the day.
On the Budapest Commodity Exchange, the yen and Ecu accounted for most of the moderate turnover of 2.09 billion forints. Both ended mixed. -- Budapest newsroom (36 1) 327 4040
